Resolves #18645

Refs #18605

The three dock guides now teach both admitted forms of a declared perspective: a `zones` arrangement lowered against the `panes` catalog, and an already-lowered `neo.dock.zone.v1` document — told apart by the record's `schema`, admitted through the checks a supplied `dockModel` passes, captured as that name's baseline byte-for-byte and never registered with a topology Group. That is the form a host that supplies its own document uses to declare the arrangement it ships. One clause per document, no new preview; the ADR already carried the amendment.

`Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029 (§2.1 as amended by the lowered-document leaf)`.

Evidence: L1 (documents; no unit tests for prose) → L2 required by the ticket's second criterion (a unit-runtime receipt written before the sentences) — achieved below at this head. Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: docs — three clauses inside existing guide sections, no new preview, no code.
